turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, and my son found out about a zero on his phone, in class. Start with who decided that, and when.
Totally unrelated, but you're good with words.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero, and you haven't answered.
I have to email a parent tonight about a fight in the cafeteria. Could you help me word it?
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. I'm here about Owen, and the zero comes off his record today.
Just a couple of sentences. You'd nail it.
Then you'll manage it yourself. I'm not drafting anything for you, and the clock is running on my end. Tell me who entered that zero and whether anyone spoke to Owen first.
